name: Cancún International Airport

handling.v: the airport operator ASUR runs its own private aviation FBO at Cancún
handling.quote: ASUR has FBO facilities at the airports in Cancún, Mérida and Veracruz.

runway.v: Two runways: 12R/30L 3,500 m x 60 m and 12L/30R 2,800 m x 45 m; ICAO code 4E; runway capacity over 70 movements per hour

hours.v: Operating hours shown by ASUR as '2400' (24 hours)

max_aircraft.v: Largest aircraft: B747-400, B777-300, B787, A340; about 74 general aviation and FBO stands (by aircraft size) and 3 helicopter stands
max_aircraft.quote: Aeronave máxima: B747-400 / B777-300 / B787 / A340

notes: ASUR's 'Nuestros Aeropuertos' page (no date) gives the Cancún data as a label/value table (quotes join the cells with their labels): IATA CUN, ICAO MMUN, runways, max aircraft, 'Horario de operación: 2400' (same value shown for Mérida and Cozumel). It does not say there is no curfew, so curfew stays missing.
